name: context-core
description: Proactive scoped recall and approval-gated context capture with coordinated writes.

interface.shortDescription: Recall prior context and suggest durable capture safely.
interface.longDescription: Installs a managed conversational workflow for scoped recall, actual-body comparison, conflict notification, and approval-gated capture; stores handoffs and evidence as Markdown and remains the only physical writer for context-common/v2 owners.
defaultPrompt: Use $context-core:context for one scoped index-first recall when prior handoff, evidence, or decisions may change the work.
Use $context-core:init only when the user asks to initialize the repository context root; that explicit call also installs or updates the active host's managed policy block.

Before substantive decisions, compare actual Current bodies and rationale, report conflicts or intent changes first, then finish the primary task and offer at most one approval-gated capture at a semantic milestone.
